name: Sergey Kolesov
description: Sergey Kolesov is a Russian-born digital artist and concept designer, currently based in Lyon, France. Known for his surreal, unsettling, and often humorous visual style, he gained international recognition for his work on Dishonored 2 , where his contributions helped shape the game’s distinctive atmosphere. Kolesov studied traditional art before transitioning to digital painting, which he found more intuitive and efficient. Entirely self-taught in digital tools, he blends classical technique with modern workflows. His portfolio spans over 200 artworks, and he’s active as a freelancer in the entertainment industry.
